a $500M private offering of unsecured senior notes due 2031.
The notes carry a 7.5% annual interest rate and mature on December 15, 2031.
The notes will be issued at 99% of face value, implying ~$495M of gross proceeds before fees and expenses.
The notes are senior unsecured obligations of Golar LNG.
The transaction is expected to settle on October 8, 2026.

title: Golar LNG prices $500M senior notes offering
